crossRefs.note: and the earth opened its mouth, and swallowed them up together with Korah when that company died; at the time the fire…
Notwithstanding, the sons of Korah didn’t die.
“Our father died in the wilderness. He was not among the company of those who gathered themselves together against…
and what he did to Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, the son of Reuben—how the earth opened its mouth and swallowed…
The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the company of Abiram.
A fire was kindled in their company. The flame burned up the wicked.

translations.web: As he finished speaking all these words, the ground that was under them split apart.
translations.bsb: As soon as Moses had finished saying all this, the ground beneath them split open,
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, as he had made an end of speaking all these words, that the ground clave asunder
translations.asv: And it came to pass, as he made an end of speaking all these words, that the ground clave asunder that was under them;
